turns.user_message: Where should we eat tonight? I'm vegetarian by the way
turns.agent_response:
Since you are looking for vegetarian options, SolToro Taqueria & Tequila Bar in the Casino of the Earth is a standout choice for a Saturday night. The aroma of fresh-pressed tortillas and charred peppers greets you as you walk in, and their menu offers authentic tacos and fresh ingredients that provide plenty of variety for a meat-free meal. They are open until 11:00 PM tonight, feature a casual dress code, and do not require reservations for their mid-range prices. 

Insider tip: Their tequila and mezcal selection is one of the most extensive on the property, so I'd suggest trying a signature margarita to pair with your tacos. After dinner, you might enjoy walking over to the Wolf Den to catch some live music. How many people are in your party tonight?

turns.user_message: What about the steakhouse? Do they have veggie options?
turns.agent_response:
Michael Jordan's Steak House in the Casino of the Sky is an excellent choice for a vegetarian who appreciates a high-end atmosphere, as their classic sides are prepared with the same reverence as their USDA Prime steaks. You can easily build a sophisticated meal out of their elevated salads and fresh vegetable dishes while enjoying the elegant, dimly lit setting that feels like a true escape from the casino floor. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, and since business casual attire is recommended, it is a perfect excuse to dress up for the evening.

Knowledge flex: The restaurant's design is inspired by Michael Jordan's own tastes, creating a space that feels both powerful and intimate, especially in the plush booth seating. After your meal, you might want to head over to the Mohegan Sun Arena to see if there is a late-show performance starting soon. I've got you covered with all the information you need, and I can certainly point you toward our hosting team to see if they can secure a table for your group. Are you looking for a full three-course dinner or something a bit lighter tonight?

For tomorrow morning, Hash House A Go Go in the Casino of the Earth is a must-visit for their legendary "Twisted Farm Food" that guests talk about for weeks after their trip. The smell of griddled batter and fresh coffee fills the space, and as a vegetarian, you will find their oversized pancakes and creative brunch dishes are incredibly satisfying. They are open from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM and have a casual atmosphere, so you can head straight there when you wake up without needing a reservation.

Pro tip: The portions here are famously massive, so if you are dining with a companion, you might consider sharing one of their signature pancakes to save room for later.
